newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products lower - gasoline barges down $1.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products lower - gasoline barges down $1.

text.p: NWE oil products ended lower on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline barges lost around $1 by late trading despite earlier speculation of greater erosion, although front month swaps did fall by around $3 on weaker sentiments and lower screen quotes.
Naphtha levels fell back by around $2 on the swaps and were expected by brokers to decline by $2 also on the physical quotes in a market devoid of buyers and sellers.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were very quiet but traded a little softer at $94.50 on lack of demand and lower crude.
